class ParseScorecardTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_header_only_and_empty_lines(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_scorecard("SCORECARD/1"), {"records": []})
        self.assertEqual(parse_scorecard("SCORECARD/1\n\n\n"), {"records": []})

    def test_decodes_fields_and_preserves_first_appearance_order(self):
        text = (
            "SCORECARD/1\n"
            "model%20one\tbase%2Flarge\t007\n"
            "caf%C3%A9\tna%C3%AFve\t100\n"
            "third\tplain\t0\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            parse_scorecard(text),
            {
                "records": [
                    {"model": "model one", "variant": "base/large", "score": 7},
                    {"model": "café", "variant": "naïve", "score": 100},
                    {"model": "third", "variant": "plain", "score": 0},
                ]
            },
        )

    def test_identical_duplicates_are_ignored_after_decoding(self):
        text = (
            "SCORECARD/1\n"
            "Alpha\tV%31\t42\n"
            "%41lpha\tV1\t42\n"
            "Beta\tV2\t9\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            parse_scorecard(text),
            {
                "records": [
                    {"model": "Alpha", "variant": "V1", "score": 42},
                    {"model": "Beta", "variant": "V2", "score": 9},
                ]
            },
        )

    def test_conflicting_duplicate_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_scorecard("SCORECARD/1\nA\tB\t1\n%41\t%42\t2")

    def test_bad_headers_are_rejected(self):
        for text in (
            "",
            "SCORECARD/2",
            " SCORECARD/1",
            "SCORECARD/1 ",
            "\ufeffSCORECARD/1",
            "\nSCORECARD/1",
        ):
            with self.subTest(text=text), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                parse_scorecard(text)

    def test_malformed_record_shapes_are_rejected(self):
        cases = (
            "SCORECARD/1\nmodel\tvariant",
            "SCORECARD/1\nmodel\tvariant\t1\textra",
            "SCORECARD/1\nmodel variant 1",
            "SCORECARD/1\n\tvariant\t1",
            "SCORECARD/1\nmodel\t\t1",
        )
        for text in cases:
            with self.subTest(text=text), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                parse_scorecard(text)

    def test_bad_percent_escapes_and_utf8_are_rejected(self):
        fields = ("bad%", "bad%1", "bad%GG", "bad%2G", "%FF", "%C3%28")
        for field in fields:
            with self.subTest(field=field), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                parse_scorecard("SCORECARD/1\n" + field + "\tvariant\t1")

    def test_scores_must_be_digits_in_range(self):
        bad_scores = ("", "-1", "+1", "1.0", " 1", "1 ", "101", "999")
        for score in bad_scores:
            with self.subTest(score=score), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                parse_scorecard("SCORECARD/1\nmodel\tvariant\t" + score)

        self.assertEqual(
            [r["score"] for r in parse_scorecard("SCORECARD/1\na\tb\t0\nc\td\t100")["records"]],
            [0, 100],
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class ReflowPagesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_input_returns_distinct_empty_list(self):
        pages = []
        result = reflow_pages(pages)
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        self.assertIsNot(result, pages)

    def test_reflows_pages_independently(self):
        pages = [
            " First line  \n second line\n\n third line ",
            " alpha-\n beta\n gamma ",
            "one\n\ntwo\n\n\nthree",
        ]
        original = list(pages)
        result = reflow_pages(pages)
        self.assertEqual(
            result,
            ["First line second line\n\nthird line", "alphabeta gamma", "one\n\ntwo\n\nthree"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(pages, original)
        self.assertIsNot(result, pages)

    def test_whitespace_only_page_becomes_empty(self):
        pages = ["", "   \n\t\n  ", "\n\n"]
        self.assertEqual(reflow_pages(pages), ["", "", ""])

    def test_strips_every_line_before_joining(self):
        pages = ["\t first \t\r\n   second   \r\n\t\r\n  third\t"]
        self.assertEqual(reflow_pages(pages), ["first second\n\nthird"])

    def test_hyphen_joining_uses_accumulated_paragraph(self):
        pages = ["soft-\n wrap-\n ped", "a -\n b", "end-"]
        self.assertEqual(reflow_pages(pages), ["softwrapped", "a b", "end-"])

    def test_empty_lines_break_paragraph_before_hyphen_logic(self):
        pages = ["word-\n\nnext", "first\n   \n\t\nsecond"]
        self.assertEqual(reflow_pages(pages), ["word-\n\nnext", "first\n\nsecond"])

    def test_input_is_unchanged_even_with_multiple_pages(self):
        pages = ["a\nb", "c-\nd", "   "]
        identities = [id(page) for page in pages]
        snapshot = list(pages)
        result = reflow_pages(pages)
        self.assertEqual(pages, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual([id(page) for page in pages], identities)
        self.assertEqual(len(result), len(pages))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        self.assertIsNot(result, spec)
        self.assertIsNot(result["jobs"], spec["jobs"])

    def test_normalizes_paths_without_mutating_input(self):
        slash = chr(92)
        spec = {
            "jobs": [
                {
                    "source": "  ./alpha//beta/./file.txt  ",
                    "target": " " + slash + "out" + slash + slash + "final" + slash + " ",
                },
                {"source": "/leading///parts/", "target": "x/./y"},
            ]
        }
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(spec)
        result = normalize_rename_spec(spec)
        self.assertEqual(
            result,
            {
                "jobs": [
                    {"source": "alpha/beta/file.txt", "target": "out/final"},
                    {"source": "leading/parts", "target": "x/y"},
                ]
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(spec, snapshot)
        self.assertIsNot(result, spec)
        self.assertIsNot(result["jobs"], spec["jobs"])
        for output_job, input_job in zip(result["jobs"], spec["jobs"]):
            self.assertIsNot(output_job, input_job)

    def test_shared_job_alias_is_preserved_only_inside_copy(self):
        shared = {"source": " ./a//b ", "target": " c/./d "}
        spec = {"jobs": [shared, shared]}
        result = normalize_rename_spec(spec)
        self.assertIs(result["jobs"][0], result["jobs"][1])
        self.assertIsNot(result["jobs"][0], shared)
        self.assertEqual(result["jobs"][0], {"source": "a/b", "target": "c/d"})
        self.assertEqual(shared, {"source": " ./a//b ", "target": " c/./d "})

    def test_invalid_top_level_structures_are_rejected(self):
        cases = (
            None,
            [],
            {},
            {"jobs": [], "extra": 1},
            {"other": []},
            {"jobs": ()},
            {"jobs": "not a list"},
        )
        for spec in cases:
            with self.subTest(spec=spec), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                normalize_rename_spec(spec)

    def test_invalid_jobs_are_rejected(self):
        cases = (
            {"jobs": [None]},
            {"jobs": [[]]},
            {"jobs": [{}]},
            {"jobs": [{"source": "a"}]},
            {"jobs": [{"source": "a", "target": "b", "extra": "c"}]},
            {"jobs": [{"source": 1, "target": "b"}]},
            {"jobs": [{"source": "a", "target": None}]},
        )
        for spec in cases:
            with self.subTest(spec=spec), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                normalize_rename_spec(spec)

    def test_empty_and_parent_paths_are_rejected(self):
        bad_paths = ("", "   ", "/", "././", "..", "a/../b", "../a")
        for path in bad_paths:
            with self.subTest(path=path), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
